<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>public</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_1902784_refund.RefundCurrencyConverter</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description/><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>RefundCurrencyConverter</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var RefundCurrencyConverter = Class.create();
RefundCurrencyConverter.prototype = {
    initialize: function() {},

    getUsdRate: function() {
        try {
            var r = new sn_ws.RESTMessageV2('FreeCurrencyAPI', 'Default GET');
            
            // O ServiceNow enviará automaticamente o Header configurado no registro REST
            var response = r.execute();
            
            var responseBody = response.getBody();
            if (responseBody) {
                responseBody = responseBody.toString(); 
            }
            
            var httpStatus = response.getStatusCode();

            // Log de depuração para validar a resposta
            gs.info("Refund Integration - Status: " + httpStatus + " | Body: " + responseBody);

            if (httpStatus == 200 && responseBody) {
                var obj = JSON.parse(responseBody);
                
                if (obj && obj.data && obj.data.USD) {
                    // Retorna a taxa como string para o Flow
                    return obj.data.USD.toString(); 
                }
            } else {
                gs.error("RefundCurrencyConverter: Falha na API. Status " + httpStatus);
            }
        } catch (ex) {
            gs.error("RefundCurrencyConverter Erro Crítico: " + ex.message);
        }
        
        return "0"; 
    },

    type: 'RefundCurrencyConverter'
};]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-04-30 12:13:59</sys_created_on><sys_id>e34b97358368c35027aba6d0deaad339</sys_id><sys_mod_count>5</sys_mod_count><sys_name>RefundCurrencyConverter</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Refund" source="x_1902784_refund">7ef79c0d83240f1027aba6d0deaad34c</sys_package><sys_policy>read</sys_policy><sys_scope display_value="Refund">7ef79c0d83240f1027aba6d0deaad34c</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_e34b97358368c35027aba6d0deaad339</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-04-30 12:38:20</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
